comment: Map/render verification boot for pools_of_ilys_1.0.0 — the ONLY map in the imported set that exercises the missing-channel splat-normal stand-in (splat_normal_0/1/3 resolve, 2 is absent and gets a neutral mid-grey 1x1, a deliberate commented non-reproduction of Recoil's unbound-sampler-reads-black bug; see PLAN-maps M8c). Two start positions only. No scenario on purpose: this boots the game_start stub force so it stays a pure terrain/minimap check independent of war content. A copy of this file must also live in client/public/ — that, not manifests/, is what ?direct= fetches (M8b finding 4).
name: dev:pools-of-ilys-verify-solo
